scope.summary: Implement the repeating print layer (CG-20, MD Print on Fabric): a fabric-level print layer with repeat modes Block/HalfDrop/Brick/Diamond/Stripe, spacing/shift parameters, face selection, and PBR blending with the base fabric maps, as a typed layer kind in the 13.9 §4 graphic layer system.
acceptance_criteria: PrintLayer (image ref, repeat_mode enum, spacing/shift, rotation, scale, face front|back|both, blend mode) tiles across all panels sharing the fabric (fabric-level, unlike per-panel graphic layers) in pattern-space so repeats stay grain-true across seams.
Half-drop/brick/diamond offsets mathematically correct (golden-image tests); stripe mode supports direction + width.
Print layer composites in the 13.9 §4 z-order with blend modes and bakes into UV-space textures (MT-380) and exports.
Layer round-trips CRDT + versioning and is settable via the texture MCP tools.
scope.risk_if_missed: Repeating prints (florals, checks, dots) are most of real-world fabric; without repeat modes every print garment needs hand-tiled graphics that break at seams.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
